observations: Photo 0 shows a small blue toy-style electronic keyboard/piano with cartoon animal graphics and a handle.
Photo 0 shows only a few large keys/buttons (not a full-size piano keyboard).
Photo 1 shows the back with no clearly readable brand/model label; text is not legible enough to identify the exact model.
No adapter, speaker, screen, or ports are shown in the photos.

claims.claim: A blue electronic piano with all blue songs and other songs preloaded
claims.evidence: Photos show a toy-style keyboard but do not show the song list, storage, or any playback screen.
No mode/menu or demo of learning features is shown.

claims.claim: All keys and buttons working, adapter included.
claims.evidence: Photos do not show an adapter or a working test; no close-ups of all controls.

claims.claim: Bought from the UK, no dead key, no crackle.
claims.evidence: No proof of purchase origin; no audio/video test to confirm no crackle.

risks.risk: The item in the photos may be a small toy keyboard (few keys) rather than the higher-end portable grand keyboard the comparables suggest; this affects value.
risks.proof: Ask for a photo showing the full front with the entire keybed (all keys visible) and a side-by-side comparison to a ruler/phone for scale.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a basic toy electronic keyboard (worst case: not a full-size/brand-name portable grand).

risks.risk: Adapter may be missing or may not match the required voltage/plug.
risks.proof: Ask for a clear photo of the adapter label (voltage/amp) and the exact port it connects to on the keyboard.

risks.risk: Some keys/buttons may be dead or intermittent (seller claims 'all working' but no test shown).
risks.proof: Ask for a short video pressing every key left-to-right and showing sound output (or a key-by-key test).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully working (worst case: at least one key/button may be dead).

risks.risk: Sound quality issues (crackle/distortion) can’t be confirmed from still images.
risks.proof: Ask for a video recording of a few notes/chords at low and higher volume.
risks.if_unproven: Price as possible crackle/distortion (worst case: not clean audio).

proof_requests: Send a clear photo of the full front showing every key/button (entire keybed visible).
Send a clear photo of the adapter and its label (voltage/amp) plus a photo of the keyboard’s charging/power port.
Send a short video testing all keys/buttons (left-to-right) with audible output.
Send a short audio/video sample showing clean sound (no crackle) at low and higher volume.
response.reason: The photos show a small toy-style electronic keyboard, but the seller’s claims (song preload, teaching modes, all keys working, adapter included, UK origin) and the exact model are not verifiable from the images. Without proof of full key count/model and working test, a reliable price pick isn’t possible.
